data.name: Jibraeel
data.gender_notes: Jibraeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Most Generous. In Islamic tradition, Jibraeel is the angel of revelation, who brings divine messages from Allah to the prophets. The name Jibraeel carries the meaning “Gentle, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jibraeel usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Angel of Mercy and Revelation
data.etymology: Jibraeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jibraeel total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: جبريل
in_arabic.meaning: الله تعالى کا ایک وفادار ملائکہ، روح القدس
in_arabic.long_meaning: جبريل اسم علم مذكر هو من الأسماء التي تطلق على الملائكة، وهو اسم خاص بالملك الذي يسميه الله تعالى في القرآن الكريم، وهو الملك الموكل بالوحي إلى الأنبياء، ويسمى أيضاً روح القدس، وهو من الأسماء التي ذكرت في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: جبرئیل
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک وفادار فرشتہ، روح القدس
in_urdu.long_meaning: جبرئیل ایک معروف فرشتہ ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے طرف سے انبیاء تک وحی لانے کے لئے مقرر کیا گیا ہے، اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی کیا گیا ہے، اور یہ روح القدس کے نام سے بھی جانا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जिब्रिल
in_hindi.meaning: एक ईमानदार दूत, परमेश्वर का दूत
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिब्रिल एक प्रसिद्ध दूत है जो परमेश्वर द्वारा पैगंबरों तक संदेश लाने के लिए नियुक्त किया गया है, इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी किया गया है, और यह आत्मा के नाम से भी जाना जाता है

in_pashto.name: جبراييل
in_pashto.meaning: د خدای یو وفادار فرښته، د روح القدس
in_pashto.long_meaning: جبراييل د فرښتو يو نوم دی چې د خدای تعالی لخوا د انبياءو ته د وحې راوړلو لپاره ټاکل شوی دی، دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، او د روح القدس په نامه هم يادېږي

data.cultural_impact: Jibraeel is an essential figure in Islamic culture, particularly known for his role as the angel of revelation. He is mentioned frequently in the Quran, and his name is synonymous with the delivery of divine messages from Allah to his prophets. The Arabic word Jibraeel comes from the root words j-b-r, which means "to flow, to be generous." The name further highlights Jibraeel's role as a conduit for Allah's messages.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Jibraeel represents the connection between Allah and His prophets. He bridges the gap between the Creator and His creations. As the conveyor of Allah's divine messages, Jibraeel is a powerful reminder of the divine guidance and presence that every individual can access. The name Jibraeel, which signifies the Most Generous, is a testament to the ultimate generosity of Allah, who continuously shares His wisdom, teachings, and love with His people through the angel Jibraeel.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gentle, Generous" symbolizes The Most Generous. In Islamic tradition, Jibraeel is the angel of revelation, who brings divine messages from Allah to the prophets.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Jibraeel serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gentle, generous.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: The angel Jibraeel is mentioned in the Quran as the one who revealed the message of Allah to the Prophet Muhammad.

trends: increasing popularity as a given name in Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jibraeel remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
